clinical_intent: I am treating a 55-year-old female with a 4 cm vulvar cancer (squamous cell, Stage II, 8 mm depth of invasion, 2 mm margins after radical vulvectomy). She has bilateral inguinal lymph node dissection with 1 of 12 nodes positive on the left. She needs adjuvant therapy. Should I recommend adjuvant radiation to the vulvar bed and inguinal regions? What dose and fractionation should I use? What concurrent chemotherapy would be appropriate? Should I consider brachytherapy boost to the vulvar bed?
